display_long_description:
**Remember the old shop on the corner? The street before it changed? Go back and see it again.**

Revisit lets you explore real places at different points in time using Google Street View. Search for a location, choose from available imagery dating back to 2007, and look around in 8K 360°.

[media]

# Compare Then and Now in 8K

Grab the **Time Rift** and drag it across the scene. One side shows the place today. The other shows an earlier date.

Choose the dates you want to compare, then change the Rift with glow, glitch, vintage, and other effects.

[media]

# Point and Walk in 8K

Point to where you want to go and walk there. Keep choosing your next spot to move through the streets step by step.

Use the satellite map to see where you are, change direction, or jump to another location.

Street View coverage, image quality, and available dates vary by location.

[media]

# Fly the World in 3D

Want to see more? Take off and fly over cities, mountains, and coastlines with **Fly in 3D**, available as an optional add-on.

[media]

# Start Anywhere

Pick one of our hand-selected locations and themed journeys, including changing landmarks, World Cup stadiums, and places behind major news stories.

[media]

# Hear What’s Happening There

Turn on **Local Radio** to listen to stations from the place you are visiting.

Open local headlines, then visit the streets and landmarks behind the story.

[media]

**Go back and take a look. You might be surprised by what you remember.**

Discord: https://discord.gg/X5pZxBdcgn

Email: support@revisitvr.com
